<a id="projectconf-env-board"></a>

# `board` {#board}

- **Type:** String
- **Multiple values:** No

*PlatformIO* has pre-configured settings for the most popular boards:

- build configuration
- upload configuration
- debugging configuration
- connectivity information, etc.

You can find a valid  `board` ID in [Boards](/hardware/boards) catalog, [Boards Explorer](https://platformio.org/boards) or [pio boards](../../cli/pio-boards.md) command.
